digo_source: Pakia (2005) App. III; Maundu & Tengnäs 2005 (Mdungu, Mudhungu)

teaser.en: Its trunk is studded with corky knobs, each tipped with a prickle, and its crushed leaves smell of lemon.
teaser.sw: Shina lake limejaa vinundu vya gamba laini, kila kimoja kikiwa na mwiba ncha yake, na majani yake yakipondwa hunukia kama limau.

summary.en: *Mdungu*, the knobwood, is a spiny tree of dry bushland and coastal thicket with corky, prickle-tipped knobs on its trunk. It is a popular Digo medicine, boiled for malaria, and also gives a spice, a tea and toothbrushes.
summary.sw: *Mdungu*, au mjafari, ni mti wenye miiba wa vichaka vikavu na vichaka vizito vya pwani, wenye vinundu vya gamba laini vyenye miiba kwenye shina lake. Ni dawa maarufu ya Kidigo, huchemshwa kutibu malaria, na pia hutoa kiungo, chai na miswaki.

about.en:
*Mdungu* is a spiny tree up to about 8 metres. Its trunk carries large corky knobs, each tipped with a sharp prickle, which make it one of the easiest trees in the bush to recognise.

The leaves are compound and smell of lemon when crushed, a sign of the citrus family it belongs to. The small round fruits ripen red and split open to show shiny black seeds.
about.sw:
*Mdungu* ni mti wenye miiba unaofikia hadi mita 8 hivi. Shina lake lina vinundu vikubwa vya gamba laini, kila kimoja kikiwa na mwiba mkali ncha yake, na hivyo kuufanya kuwa mojawapo ya miti rahisi zaidi kutambua porini.

Majani yake ni ya mchanganyiko na hunukia kama limau yakipondwa, ishara ya familia ya michungwa ambayo ni yake. Matunda yake madogo ya mviringo huiva yakawa mekundu na kupasuka kuonyesha mbegu nyeusi zinazong'aa.

where.en: It grows in dry bushland and coastal thicket. Look for its knobbly trunk at the edge of bush paths.
where.sw: Hukua katika vichaka vikavu na vichaka vizito vya pwani. Tafuta shina lake lenye vinundu kando ya njia za porini.

uses.en:
The root bark is boiled as a remedy for malaria, and Pakia records it as a popular general medicine among the Digo.

The fruits and leaves are used as a spice and to make tea, and its twigs are chewed as toothbrushes.
uses.sw:
Gome la mizizi huchemshwa kama dawa ya malaria, na Pakia anarekodi kuwa ni dawa maarufu ya jumla miongoni mwa Wadigo.

Matunda na majani hutumika kama kiungo na kutengenezea chai, na vitawi vyake hutafunwa kama miswaki.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo names *mdungu* and *mjafari*; Maundu and Tengnäs give *mdungu* and *mudhungu*. In Swahili it is *mjafari*. Giriama speakers say *mudhungu* or *mjafari*, and Chonyi speakers *mdungu*. In English it is knobwood, and its scientific name is *Zanthoxylum chalybeum*.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi majina ya Kidigo *mdungu* na *mjafari*; Maundu na Tengnäs wanatoa *mdungu* na *mudhungu*. Kwa Kiswahili ni *mjafari*. Wazungumzaji wa Kigiriama husema *mudhungu* au *mjafari*, na wa Kichonyi *mdungu*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *knobwood*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Zanthoxylum chalybeum*.

reason.en: Same citrus family; its root bark is also boiled for malaria
reason.sw: Familia moja ya michungwa; gome la mizizi yake pia huchemshwa kwa malaria
Chanzo kingine cha vitawi vya miswaki

reason.en: Another tree used by the Digo for malaria
reason.sw: Mti mwingine unaotumiwa na Wadigo kwa malaria
